name: Amg8833 Motion Detector
description: Use the AMG8833 thermal camera as a motion sensor. Every 200 ms, read all 64 pixels and count how many pixels changed by more than 1.0 C since the previous frame (smaller changes are sensor noise). Once per second, print the largest count seen in that second and whether there is motion: yes if that count is 4 or more, otherwise no. Print a motion-detected line once at the start of each period of motion (when motion goes from no to yes). The AMG8833 is at I2C address 0x69.
